title: Local Delivery | CastleLeaf
description: Local cannabis delivery from CastleLeaf in Brighton, MA. Order online, choose Home Delivery and keep a valid government ID handy. For adults 21 and older.
lede: Cannabis quickly delivered straight to your door. Browse the menu from the sofa, choose Home Delivery, and keep your ID within reach for the knock.

items.title: Browse the live menu
items.text: Open our menu and take your time. Wander the categories, read the product details and fill your cart at your own pace.

items.title: Choose Home Delivery
items.text: Place your order online and choose Home Delivery. Rather collect it yourself? Pick-up in-store is right there as well.

items.title: Have your ID ready
items.text: Keep a valid government ID that shows you're 21 or older close at hand for when your order arrives.

items.title: Someone 21+ receives it
items.text: An adult 21 or older takes the order in person, ID in hand. Then it's all yours to enjoy at home, on private property.

blocks.html: Ready when you are: open the menu and start a delivery order.
Got a question before you order? Call us at (617) 202-5066 and we'll talk it through with you.
Delivery is one door into CastleLeaf. There are three more, and you're welcome to use whichever suits the day.

items: Order Online for pick-up. Order from home and swing by when you're ready. See Our Menu.
Walk-in Express. Place an order at our in-store kiosk and shop in peace.
In-store Budtender Experience. Speak to a Budtender or visit our Fresh Counter at the store, where our highly educated budtenders are glad to show you around.

blocks.html: You'll find us at 100 Leo M Birmingham Pkwy, Brighton, MA 02135, with plenty of on site parking in our lot and street parking out front.

items.a_html: An adult 21 or older with a valid government ID. The simplest plan is to be home yourself, with your ID ready, when the order arrives.

items.q: Can I order for pickup instead?
items.a_html: Yes. When you order online you can choose pick-up in-store or Home Delivery. Order from home and swing by when you're ready: we're at 100 Leo M Birmingham Pkwy in Brighton.

items.q: Can I talk to a budtender first?
items.a_html: Please do. Give us a call at (617) 202-5066 or stop by and chat with one of our budtenders. Booking a budtender online is coming soon on our Book A Budtender page.
